title: Manhunter #1-8 Lot DC 2004 1st App Kate Spencer Andreyko Jae Lee Identity Crisis
conditionDescription: All eight covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Manhunter #1-8 (DC Comics, Oct 2004 - May 2005) - the first eight issues of the Marc Andreyko series, including #1 with the FIRST APPEARANCE of Kate Spencer as Manhunter. Art by Jesus Saiz and Jimmy Palmiotti; covers by Jae Lee and Jose Villarrubia (#1-5) and Jesus Saiz (#6-8). #5 is an Identity Crisis tie-in. Original $2.50 cover price each.

You get all 8 issues:
- #1 (Oct 04) She Stalks the World's Most Dangerous Game - 1st Kate Spencer
- #2 (Nov 04) Taking It to the Streets!
- #3 (Dec 04) Darkness Falls!
- #4 (Jan 05) Lock & Load!
- #5 (Feb 05) Identity Crisis tie-in with Hawkman and Martian Manhunter
- #6 (Mar 05) Trial by Fire Part One
- #7 (Apr 05)
- #8 (May 05) Besieged!

Back covers include Babylon 5, Smallville, King of Fighters, The Librarian, Crusade, Resident Evil 4 and Constantine game ads.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
